newsitem.title: HAITI: U.N. police trainer attacked in Haitian slum.
newsitem.headline: U.N. police trainer attacked in Haitian slum.

text.p: An Algerian police trainer was shot and wounded while patrolling on Saturday in a Port-au-Prince slum of Cite Soleil, according to U.N. sources.
"He was shot in the arm, and taken to the hospital," said U.N. Civilian Police officer Jean Binet.
U.N. officials would not release the name of the wounded man, saying the incident was still under investigation. He was one of two Algerians working at the Cite Soleil police post.
Cite Soleil has been terrorized by gang violence, which left as many as 11 people dead last month. U.N. civilian police trainers have been helping the Haitian National Police in securing the area.
